cards.title: Constraints Fuel Innovation
cards.insight: Creative breakthroughs often emerge not from unlimited resources but from working within tight boundaries. When creators face restrictions—time, budget, materials—they're forced to question assumptions and find novel solutions. Limitations can paradoxically liberate unconventional thinking.
cards.takeaway: Set deliberate creative constraints on your next project: a time box, budget cap, or single tool limitation to spark unexpected approaches.

cards.title: Cross-Domain Borrowing
cards.insight: The most original ideas rarely come from staying within one discipline. Importing concepts, methods, or aesthetics from unrelated fields creates cognitive collisions that generate fresh perspectives. A musician borrowing from architecture, or an engineer inspired by jazz improvisation, produces combinations no single domain could generate alone.
cards.takeaway: Spend time exploring a field completely unlike your own work; actively look for one principle or technique to transpose into your creative practice.

cards.title: Iteration Over Inspiration
cards.insight: Waiting for creative lightning to strike is unreliable. Sustained creativity comes from showing up regularly, making small tweaks, and treating each attempt as feedback rather than failure. The accumulation of iterations—not sudden genius—builds genuinely novel work over time.
cards.takeaway: Commit to a daily or weekly creative practice with low stakes; focus on quantity and refinement rather than chasing perfection in isolated bursts.

cards.title: Productive Collaboration Paradox
cards.insight: While brainstorming groups often reinforce existing ideas through groupthink, structured creative collaboration—where individuals think independently first, then share—produces more novel solutions. Diverse perspectives combined through dialogue outperform solo genius.
cards.takeaway: Invite collaborators to think alone on a problem first, then convene to share ideas; this hybrid model balances individual creativity with collective refinement.
